newsitem.title: USA: Air Express Intl opens new Canadian office.
newsitem.headline: Air Express Intl opens new Canadian office.

text.p: Air Express International said it has opened a full-service office in Calgary.
Until now, the company was represented in Calgary by agency partner Cole Freight, which will continue to represent AEI in Edmonton and Winnipeg.
The Calgary office will be headed by Alan Horabin, who worked previously for a large Japanese logistics company.

AEI said its Canadian revenues have tripled over the past four years. Calgary has one of Canada's fastest growing economies and is the centre of the country's oil, gas and beef cattle industries. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017 dg
